## Conventions, in three lines

- **Units** — coordinates are in **metres**, except `Insertion.from_dict`, which takes micrometres.
- **Origin** — **bregma**, so bregma is `(0, 0, 0)`.
- **Signs** — ML `+` right / `−` left; AP `+` anterior / `−` posterior; DV `+` dorsal / `−` ventral,
  so deeper is more negative.

Coordinates are ordered **(ML, AP, DV)**; the atlas image volumes are indexed **(AP, ML, DV)**.
[Coordinates and volumes](../explanation/coordinates-and-volumes.qmd) has the full table.

::: {.callout-warning}
The DV convention is stated incorrectly in the `iblatlas` module docstring, which the generated
API pages reproduce verbatim. Where the two disagree, the line above is the correct one.
:::

## Contents

- **[API](api/index.qmd)** — every documented class and function, grouped by theme.
- **[Data files](data-files.qmd)** — the fixtures shipped with the package and the files it

The API pages are generated from the source docstrings. If a symbol is missing it has either
